title: Zico Kolter Joins OpenAI’s Board of Directors
summary: Zico Kolter Joins OpenAI’s Board of Directors We’re strengthening our governance with expertise in AI safety and alignment. Zico will also join the Safety & Security Committee
body: Zico Kolter Joins OpenAI’s Board of Directors We’re strengthening our governance with expertise in AI safety and alignment. Zico will also join the Safety & Security Committee
summaryZh: Zico Kolter正式加入OpenAI董事会，并同步加入安全与安全委员会。此举旨在通过引入人工智能安全和对齐方面的专业知识，进一步强化OpenAI的机构治理结构。
